text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! ♪ Toughness bars
are on sale
right now, you know. And
guess what?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
For extra hard workers like you, they're
free!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You know how you forget to eat during
work
sometimes? You know, so you
don't want to
waste time. That's exactly
when a hearty snack
like this comes in
handy.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and be sure to tell me what you
think after
you try them. My manager
wants opinions before
we expand the
sales area. So yeah, let me
know! ♪
